t: Weekly meal planner and smart shopping list

Create your favorite dishes with their ingredients, drag them onto a seven-day schedule, and let the app combine matching quantities into a shopping list organized by store section, with options to copy and print it.
Plan your weekly meals and calculate your groceries automatically

Yes, you can prepare your whole week in minutes: create each dish with its ingredients and quantities, then drag it to the right day in the planning grid, and automatic calculation will combine ingredients that appear in multiple meals, then sort the result into one shopping list by store section. This approach needs no internet connection, server, account, or browser storage; everything stays right there on the page while you use it, and you can export your data to a JSON file and import it again later when needed. Print a copy or copy the text into any app, and get ready to shop without forgetting anything or buying duplicates.

How do I add a new dish?
Enter the dish name, then add each ingredient with its quantity, unit, and store section. Once the ingredients are complete, press Save dish.
Can I edit the weekly schedule?
Yes; drag the dish to the desired day, or choose the dish, day, and meal from the schedule tools. You can remove any meal from inside its cell.
How are quantities calculated in the shopping list?
Each ingredient quantity is multiplied by the number of times the dish repeats, then matching items are combined, kilograms are converted to grams, and liters to milliliters.
What happens to my data when I close the page?
Your data isn't saved in the browser. Export a JSON file before leaving if you want to keep your dishes and meal plan, then import it later.
